about: AEW's shipped skills (register E127; ADR-0006, amendment 2026-11-05). Each changes only by a pull request that re-hashes this file. Every skill is unevaluated: released for the personal alpha only. `lead` is the Lead's own list (register E161; ADR-0006, amendment 2026-11-25): skills offered to the Lead, never to a role card.
